items.text: Patriots ruled out RB TreVeyon Henderson for Sunday’s game in Germany against the Lions (illness).
items.implication: NE backfield volume opens with Stevenson also limited/DNP
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/carries for remaining Pats RBs (e.g. Kiner types)

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay said the team will not place Puka Nacua on IR due to roster mechanics, but the WR will still be out for a significant period of time with MCL/PCL sprains and turf toe.
items.why: Roster semantics; significant multi-week absence expected
items.implication: Rams WR depth thins further with Adams also out; no early activation needed
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Rams WRs (Atwell/Whittington/Mumpfield types) and run lean

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will have surgery later this week on broken ring finger and could return as quickly as 2-3 weeks; out vs Vikings, IR decision Saturday but not guaranteed.
items.why: No grip strength; surgery opted; bye helps timeline
items.implication: Short-term miss preferred over IR; stashable

items.text: A.J. Brown returned to practice (from broader injury updates); positive step toward availability.
items.implication: Boost for NE pass game/Maye if plays

items.text: There are scenarios where Davante Adams (hamstring) plays and Puka Nacua (knee/toe) does not for some of fantasy's most important weeks; discussed on ROS rankings show. Rams expected to lean more negative PROE without both.
items.why: Adams surgery expedited return; targeting post-Week 12 Packers for Week 13 Chiefs possible
items.implication: Adams ROS value higher than full IR multi-week miss; Nacua longer absence
items.opportunity: Adams could return for stretch run while Nacua still out

items.text: Chiefs listed QB Patrick Mahomes as a full participant in today’s practice, putting him on track to play Sunday at Atlanta.

PROE notes: Vikings positive despite bad QB play—could spike with Cousins (KOC wants to throw). Healthy Burrow/Chase/Higgins Bengals cook. Expect Rams more negative PROE sans Nacua/Adams. Bucs negative makes sense with elite D/OL/Irving.
items.why: Last four games PROE data + scheme/personnel
items.opportunity: Elevated pass volume for Jefferson/Chase; more RB work LAR

items.text: Worried about Brock Bowers with Fernando Mendoza at QB? Bowers put up monster rookie numbers with O’Connell/Minshew/Ridder; he’ll be just fine.
items.why: Proven with multiple QBs; target monster remains
items.implication: Maintain elite TE1 ranking despite rookie QB growing pains
corroboration: ETR fallout notes lower floor but elite

items.text: Vikings acquire Kirk Cousins: Jefferson value vaults to WR1 territory given historical 106.8 ypg/10.2 YPT with Cousins; offense likely more pass-heavy under KOC trust. Addison hold.
items.why: Cousins upgrade over carousel (higher YPA/EPA); familiar scheme
items.implication: Jefferson immediate WR1 bump; pass rate spike possible

items.text: Ashton Jeanty biggest loser among Raiders with Cousins traded: led RBs in targets/route (0.30); Cousins checked down heavily. Mendoza/rookie likely fewer easy looks; lower scoring env.
items.why: Checkdown volume drop + offense downgrade per market
items.implication: Jeanty receiving work/floor hit; Bowers still elite but lower floor

items.text: Travis Etienne designated to resume practicing / returned to practice for Saints, creating murky backfield with Kamara.
items.implication: Timeshare risk for Kamara; Etienne ramp

items.text: Jordyn Tyson's time is coming, but it's not this week. I am CLOSING IT OUT on Tyson in week 10.
items.why: Not ready for full role yet post-debut

items.text: I am KEEPING IT OPEN on Jadarian Price, even with Charb back.
Yes the Cowboys have CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens. Yes I’m still telling you to pick up Ryan Flournoy. There’s room for him in this offense.
